# Desanāhāravibhaṅga (Ne 4)

**Section:** Netti (ne)

**Title (Pali):** Desanāhāravibhaṅga

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Desanāhāravibhaṅga* ("Conveying a Teaching: Analysis") is the fourth section of the *Netti* (Nettippakaraṇa). It constitutes the detailed analysis (*vibhaṅga*) of the *desanāhāra*, the first of the sixteen modes of conveying (*hāranaya*) that provide an analytical methodology facilitating knowledge and doctrinal scrutiny [Khemananda 1993]. In this hermeneutical method, the exposition elaborates the meaning of a discourse through categories such as gratification, disadvantages, emancipation, fruit, means, and injunction; under this rule, even if only one such category is explicitly formulated in a discourse, the rest are to be supplied [Khemananda 1993].
